name: Stay Alive For Me
source:
A psychological horror visual novel inspired by the indie thriller movie Connection. You play as Allie, trapped with a disturbed captor, and every choice you make brings you closer to the truth...or to doom.

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4040810/Stay_Alive_For_Me/]Steam[/url]]
